description: This file defines the DefaultCommandManager class, which implements command execution and matching logic for a command-line interface within the OrchardCore project. It manages command handlers, matches input commands to handlers, and executes the appropriate command.

classes.name: DefaultCommandManager
classes.description: Manages command execution and matching logic, utilizing command handlers and descriptors.

classes.name: Match
classes.description: Represents a matched command with its context and handler.

methods.name: ExecuteAsync
methods.description: Executes a command based on input parameters, matching commands and handling errors.

methods.name: GetCommandDescriptors
methods.description: Retrieves all command descriptors from registered command handlers.

methods.name: MatchCommands
methods.description: Matches input parameters to available commands.
